extraction.description: The screenshot shows UiPath Studio Web with the ActionSchema tab open for a Benefit Claims Processing project. In the Explorer panel, the Action folder is expanded and ActionSchema is selected. The main editor is configuring a human validation action schema with outcomes Approve and Reject, several input properties such as Summary, EligibilityStatus, Calculation, and fraud-related fields, plus an output property named DenialReason.
extraction.step_instructions: Click on Action > ActionSchema in the Explorer if it is not already selected. In the Outcomes section, ensure the available decisions are Approve and Reject. In the Input Properties section, verify or add the required fields including Summary, EligibilityStatus, Calculation, fraud-related fields, ApplicationFile..., and PaystubFilePath with the shown data types. In the Output Properties section, add or verify the DenialReason field as System.String.
